name: Layout Principles
description: Produces layout analysis and recommendations using grid alignment, visual hierarchy rules, white space ratios, and focal point placement with specific measurements and ratios. Use when the user asks to improve a layout, apply layout principles, fix spacing issues, evaluate grid alignment, or optimize visual balance in a design. Do NOT use for wireframing from scratch (use wireframe-specification), responsive breakpoint design (use responsive-layout-design), or typography-specific issues (use typography-system).
